title: RICHER ANIMATION: HIT JOLTS AND DEATHS
why: His pick from the feature list. A body that is hit is drawn jolted a few pixels away from the player who hit it while its hit flash runs, and a body that dies leaves a silhouette in its colour that turns, flattens and fades over 0.8 seconds where it fell, in both windows of a party. It is drawing only: nothing a fight reads moves.
